purpose: Machine-verifiable mandatory reading and gate sequence for zero-context AllinCMS new-site builds.

required_markers: AllinCMS 文章 create 的资格验证

completion_gates: Plan A create-site before/after unique-id delta pass
product reviewed create/update and product-content gate pass
article create qualification five-step pass or deployment-evidence BLOCK with unlock attempt
seven-page globals and route activation pass
demo cleanup dry-run approval and reconciliation complete
audit/gate/contact/product-content pass or explicit platform-boundary evidence
fail_closed_rules: A document statement that a capability is BLOCKED is not deployment evidence.
A canonical Registry route without an executable canonical handler is CONTRACT_FRESHNESS_DRIFT.
No create request may retry after request_started without authoritative exact-absence proof; article create never auto-retries.
Unpublished COP content requires both deployment evidence and a recorded unlock attempt before delivery can be signed.
